column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a trap” is rendered “a snare.”
NKJV renders “the rebels have gone deep in slaughter, and I [am] a discipline to all of them” as “The revolters are deeply involved in slaughter, Though I rebuke them all”; the meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “they do not permit their deeds to return” is rendered “They do not direct their deeds Toward turning.”
Close to the Hebrew; “strange children” is rendered “pagan children,” and “their portions” “their heritage.”
Close to the Hebrew; “after you, O Benjamin” is rendered “Look behind you, O Benjamin!”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who displace a boundary” is rendered “those who remove a landmark.”
NKJV renders “he walked after a command” as “he willingly walked by human precept,” adding “human”; the meaning of the Hebrew word is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “the wound will not depart from you” is rendered “Nor heal you of your wound.”
Close to the Hebrew; “until they are held guilty” is rendered “Till they acknowledge their offense.”
